annotations.title: Request a time feel check (where does it drag?)

description: Request that real people experience a video, text, flow or waiting screen and report where it drags, when attention drops and how long it felt. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 39 for 5 people, EUR 69 for 10. Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

experience.description: What the panel should do, e.g. watch the full video, complete sign-up.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
